title: Kill Bots Lip Sync
eyebrow: GPOM scene A · lip-sync pass, 18 Nov · round 2 (50 clips)
heading: The toilet row: pick the best lip sync per line
intro: Round 2: ten new talking clips per line now (five more made this afternoon), every voice take fitted whole to every clip's mouth, never early, never chopped. Each line: what's in the film now, then the three best pairs out of all of them (at most one per clip, so three different pictures). New clips play their full 5-6 s with the room bed; the film version is trimmed to the line. Pick one per row ('Now in the film' keeps it) and leave a note. Derek's first line still fits badly on every clip (his mouth is faster than any take): say if you want it re-voiced faster or re-shot.

sections.lede: Sandra and Derek in the bunker toilet, five lines in film order.
